# FG-DOC-0001

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_doc_lint_problem_fails_with_doc_lint_problem` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 文書が規則に合っていません。一覧のファイルと行を直してください。
- en: A document breaks a rule. Fix the files and lines listed.
- id: Sebuah dokumen melanggar aturan. Perbaiki berkas dan baris yang dicantumkan.

## 原因 (cause)

The document lint (forge_doc::lint, plan 13 §5, ADR-0026) found a problem in a document: a `.md` file whose front matter names a `doctype`, in any folder. Two places run the same lint on the same bytes: the check `forge/doc-lint` (written by the `check.spec_index` job on a merge request version's head; it concludes `failure`) and `gstn doc lint` on the working tree (exit 1). Each problem is `path:line rule [subject]`. Rules: the text (forge_doc::document: too_large over 1 MiB, not_utf8, front matter syntax, blocks, references, html_not_allowed), the front matter (field_missing, field_invalid, field_unknown, classification_invalid / _below_default / _conflict, id_invalid, id_not_filename, id_duplicate, translation_invalid, retired_invalid), the type (doctype_unknown: no `.forge/doctypes/<type>.yml`; doctype_invalid: that definition cannot be used — FG-DOC-0003), the body (section_missing, section_order, block_kind_unknown, block_id_missing / _invalid / _duplicate, block_body_empty, block_outside_section, attr_unknown, attr_invalid, replaced_by_not_deprecated), references (ref_broken: the id or block is not in this repository; ref_kind_mismatch, ref_doctype_mismatch) and the type's own rules (e.g. every_hazard_has_control). Broken references are errors (plan 13 Q13); `gstn doc lint --migration-warnings` reports `ref_broken` as a warning instead, locally only (the repository setting that lowers them on the server with an expiry is not built yet). Not a server fault: the files are the repository's content.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Locally: gstn doc lint (or gstn doc lint <path> --json: each problem with path, line, rule, subject, level). On the server: gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head> (forge/doc-lint; the summary and the annotations list each problem). The job's log event `forge.spec_index.recorded` carries `request_id`, `project_id`, `iid`, `head_sha` and `doc_lint_conclusion`.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the document (or its type's definition) at the listed line in the merge request; run gstn doc lint before pushing. A reference to a document not yet in GitStation: add that document first (or, while migrating locally, pass --migration-warnings). Nothing to change on the server.
